summary: Add modules/automations (Automations.* and Connections.Manage permissions, settings hub entry, connection store, OAuth2 and SecretResolver wiring, AUTOMATION_PLATFORM_CREDENTIALS) with the /settings/integrations Solid screen served from an embedded bundle, solid.Bind/solid.NewRPCHandler (a JSON-RPC server for Solid screen methods) and connectors.OAuth2.Exchange (exchange and test a sign-in without saving). The extension runtime now uses a container-provided host.SecretResolver when wiring.Options.Secrets is unset.
